title: Renewal discount of the primary promo is derived from the order's combined checkout discount

bugs.note: With stacked promotions the order stores one combined discount. The renewal code gives the recurring primary promo whatever is left after subtracting only the recurring stacked shares, so a one-time promo used at checkout is counted as part of the primary's share and keeps being taken off every renewal invoice. The per-promo amounts recorded at checkout are not used, and a recorded zero is treated as missing.
